title: Blue Box Season 2 Reveals Main Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs
content: The upcoming Blue Box Season 2 revealed a main visual and trailer, along with the opening and ending theme songs on Wednesday. Singer aiko is performing “Anata no Hana no Iro” for the opening theme song, while the band elsewhere kikou sings “blue in” for the ending theme song.
author: Anime Corner

title: Red River's Chie Shinohara Launches New Historical Manga on September 24
content: The October issue of Shogakukan 's Cheese! magazine announced on Monday that manga creator Chie Shinohara will launch a new manga titled Itsukinomiya Genshitan (The Records of Itsukinomiya Visions) in the magazine's next issue on September 24.
author: ANN

title: Yurie Sekiya's Pero Pero★Sparkles Characters Get TV Anime
content: TV Tokyo announced on Wednesday that it is producing a television anime of Yurie Sekiya's Pero Pero★Sparkles characters Sekiya launched the characters in 2013, and the characters have since spawned merchandise, as well as a 2020 YouTube anime.
author: ANN

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2's New Video Previews Ending Song
content: The official website for the second season of the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean webtoon presented a new promotional video for the anime on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Shiro Yoshida Launches New Kemonogari Manga
content: Manga creator Shiro Yoshida launched a new manga titled Kemonogari (Hunting Animals) manga on DeNA 's Manga Box app on Sunday. The "panic-in-closed-village horror" manga is set in a village named Habaki, which has a strange custom that grants the head of the village supreme authority.
author: ANN

title: Ruby on the Cake: Feast of the Man-Eating Witches Manga Ends
content: This year's ninth issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine published the final chapter of Miki Morinaga 's Ruby on the Cake: Feast of the Man-Eating Witches ( Ruby on the Cake: Hitokui Majo no Bansan-kai ) manga on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Kento Amemiya's Kinato's Magic Manga Ends
content: This year's 39th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine published the final chapter of Kento Amemiya 's Kinato's Magic ( Kaigeki no Kinato ) manga on Monday. Shueisha also announced that the manga's third and fourth compiled book volumes will ship simultaneously on October 2.
author: ANN

title: Detective Conan: The Private Eyes' Requiem Manga Ends in September
content: The October issue of Shogakukan 's Shōnen Sunday S magazine revealed on Tuesday that Yutaka Abe and Jirō Maruden 's manga adaptation of Detective Conan: The Private Eyes' Requiem , the 10th anime film in the franchise , will end in the magazine's next issue in September.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Just Got Game of Thrones-Level Intense With Its Latest Twist
content: There have been many anime airing on Crunchyroll , the leading anime streaming platform; however, only a few have emerged as truly Anime of the Year material, and one anime airing this season has also emerged as one of the darkest, with its twists and premise.
author: ComicBook

title: Maria Holic Gets Sequel Series After 12 Years
content: Minari Endo announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday a new sequel series for her Maria Holic manga titled Maria Holic : Sono Ato no 12-kagetsu no Ohanashi ( Maria Holic : A Story Set 12 Months After) will launch in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine on August 27.
author: ANN
